# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| default branch | yes |
| older | no |

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you discover a security issue, **do not open a public issue.**

Instead, report it privately to Gauvreau Accounting Tax Law Advisory via:

- Email: security@gauvreaucpa.ca
- Or use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting (Security -> Report a
  vulnerability) on this repository.

Please include:

- A description of the issue and its impact
- Steps to reproduce
- Any relevant logs or proof-of-concept (without exposing live credentials)

We aim to acknowledge reports within 3 business days.

## Scope notes

These repositories contain integration tooling for sensitive legal and financial
data. Handle credentials carefully; client data must never be committed.
